chapter: Chicago memories and the road to the Navy
title: Hearing Tony Jackson at the Deluxe Cafe
summary: Red Batiste took Zutty to hear Tony Jackson upstairs at the Deluxe Cafe in Chicago, playing beautiful non-jazz music such as Pretty Baby.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well where was Tony Jackson playing in Chicago? Do you remember?

He was playing in the Deluxe Café upstairs. And Red (P) (O) (Batiste) because he knew Tony, and he knew I wanted to hear Tony. And Red (P) (O) (Batiste), he worked for the NapolitW brothers. They called it the Little Club in New Orleans. And I told him that I wanted to hear Tony and he take me out one night to hear Tony Jackson. Boy I was so proud and he played such beautiful piano you know. Not jazz, it wasn't jazz.
Yes, but I mean what sort of numbers did he play in those days?
Well I'll tell you one of the tunes he played was 'Everybody loves a baby,' [SINGS] ....
'Pretty Baby'. Well that was his song?
Yes, sure it was. Well all that type of tune.
Yes, that kind of thing, yes I see.

Well in those days, you was asking me I knew, I didn't know anything about Tony Jackson because I was going to school, where Zutty should have been going to school. But I wasn't even in the music business.
He left New Orleans way before I ....
I knew, and you were going on seventeen, but I didn't know anything about musicians
